title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant Plymouth
£25,000 to £27,000 per annum In-office
About the role
DK Recruitment is delighted to be working with a well-established law firm in Plymouth on the search for a Conveyancing Assistant to join its busy property team. This is a great opportunity for someone organised and detail-focused to support experienced fee earners and build their career in conveyancing.

Key responsibilities
- Supporting fee earners with conveyancing files from instruction through to completion
- Opening new matters, carrying out ID and source of funds checks, and preparing client care documentation
- Preparing contract packs and ordering searches
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders and other solicitors by phone and email
- Assisting with completions, post-completion work, SDLT returns and Land Registry applications
- Keeping files and case management records accurate and up to date

What our client is looking for
- Previous experience in a conveyancing or legal support role (preferred)
- Excellent organisation and time management skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Clear, friendly communication skills
- The ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced team

What s on offer
- A salary of £25,000 to £27,000 per annum
- An in-office role within a supportive, friendly team
- The opportunity to develop your conveyancing skills alongside experienced fee earners

title: Conveyancing Legal Assistant
description:
Residential Conveyancing Legal Assistant/Paralegal - Totnes, Devon

- Parking Permit

title: Legal PA
description:
Job Title: Legal PA

Location: Exeter

Salary: 33,000 per annum

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent - Monday to Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm

Hybrid Working: Typically 2-3 days per week in the office, with flexibility

Benefits:
- 33,000 annual salary
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Hybrid working and flexible approach to office attendance
- Modern Exeter office
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced legal professionals
- Excellent career development opportunities
- Stable and well-respected professional services environment

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced Personal Assistant looking for your next challenge within a professional and fast-paced environment?

We are recruiting on behalf of a professional services client for an experienced Legal PA to join their Planning & Environmental team in Exeter. This is an excellent opportunity to become a key member of a busy and highly regarded legal team, providing support to multiple fee earners and building strong relationships with both colleagues and clients.

Working within a collaborative environment, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the team while managing a varied workload and supporting stakeholders at all levels.

About the Company

Our client is a leading professional services organisation with an excellent reputation for delivering exceptional client service. They are committed to creating a supportive working environment where employees are encouraged to develop their skills and progress their careers.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing complex diaries and scheduling appointments
- Coordinating internal and external meetings
- Organising travel arrangements and itineraries
- Acting as a key point of contact for clients and stakeholders
- Managing correspondence, emails and telephone enquiries
- Producing, formatting and proofreading documentation
- Supporting billing and financial administration processes
- Maintaining accurate records and filing systems
- Assisting with presentations, pitches and business development activities
- Providing administrative support to a team of legal professionals
- Supporting colleagues across multiple office locations when required

What We're Looking For
- Previous PA experience supporting a team rather than solely 1:1 support
- Legal sector experience would be highly desirable
- Candidates from other professional services environments with strong transferable skills will also be considered
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work to tight deadlines
- Positive, proactive and solutions-focused approach
- Professional, adaptable and able to remain calm under pressure
- Accurate typing skills and a high standard of written communication

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Plymouth Part-Time, Permanent Up to £28,000 (depending on experience - Pro Rata)

We are delighted to be recruiting on behalf of our client for an experienced Legal Secretary to join their growing team in Plymouth. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional and organised Legal Secretary who enjoys providing exceptional client service and wants to play a key role within a respected and supportive law firm. The position offers flexibility around working hours and days, making it ideal for someone seeking a better work-life balance while remaining part of a collaborative and ambitious team.

Key Responsibilities:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to solicitors and fee earners.
- Managing diaries, arranging meetings, and coordinating appointments.
- Preparing legal documents, correspondence and reports.
- Opening and maintaining client files in line with firm procedures and compliance requirements.
- Liaising with clients, third parties and other professionals, delivering exceptional client care at all times.
- Handling incoming calls, emails and correspondence efficiently and professionally.
- Assisting with billing, file management and document production.

To be Successful:
- Previous experience working within a legal environment, ideally as a legal secretary
- Excellent communication and client care skills
- Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail
- The ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
- A proactive approach and the confidence to use your own initiative
- Good IT skills and experience using legal systems
- A positive, team-focused attitude

Benefits:
- Up to £28,000 DOE (Pro Rata)
- Enhanced annual leave entitlement
- Additional holiday for long service
- Company pension scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme and mental health support
- Free annual flu vaccinations
- Coaching and mentoring opportunities
- Modern, welcoming office environment
- Staff discounts on legal services
- Regular social events, team activities and firm-wide away days
- Friendly, supportive and inclusive culture

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary looking to join a highly regarded firm where your contribution will be valued and rewarded, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for this fantastic opportunity in Plymouth.
